# weka_snapshot_policy (Resource)

A snapshot schedule attached to one or more filesystems. The cluster's policy_params always carries all five schedule kinds (daily, hourly, weekly, monthly, periodic); this resource exposes the two actually used in practice, daily and hourly, and sends the other three disabled. upload is "none", "local", or "remote" and must be "remote" for a filesystem whose only object store attachment is a remote (snapshot) bucket.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "weka_snapshot_policy" "home" {
  name        = "home"
  filesystems = [weka_filesystem.home.id]

  daily = {
    enable    = true
    time      = "07:00"
    days      = "all"
    retention = 7
    upload    = "remote"
  }
}

resource "weka_snapshot_policy" "share" {
  name        = "share"
  filesystems = [weka_filesystem.share.id]

  daily = {
    enable    = true
    time      = "19:30"
    days      = "all"
    retention = 7
    upload    = "remote"
  }

  hourly = {
    enable        = true
    hours         = "all"
    days          = "all"
    minute_offset = 0
    retention     = 24
    upload        = "remote"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filesystems` (Set of String) UIDs of the filesystems this policy runs against. A set: the API does not promise a stable order.
- `name` (String) Policy name. Max 12 characters. Renaming updates in place.

### Optional

- `daily` (Attributes) Runs once a day at a fixed time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--daily))
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the whole policy is active.
- `hourly` (Attributes) Runs on an hour list within selected days. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hourly))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Snapshot policy UID.

<a id="nestedatt--daily"></a>
### Nested Schema for `daily`

Required:

- `days` (String) Comma-separated weekday names, e.g. "monday, tuesday", or "all".
- `enable` (Boolean)
- `retention` (Number)
- `time` (String) HH:MM.
- `upload` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--hourly"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hourly`

Required:

- `days` (String) Comma-separated weekday names, e.g. "monday, tuesday", or "all".
- `enable` (Boolean)
- `hours` (String) Comma-separated hours, e.g. "09, 10, 11", or "all".
- `minute_offset` (Number)
- `retention` (Number)
- `upload` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UID or by name.
terraform import weka_snapshot_policy.home policy-uid
terraform import weka_snapshot_policy.home home
```
